description: This Dart source file defines the BudgetsProvider class, which manages budget data within a Flutter application. It interacts with a repository for loading and updating budget data and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: BudgetsProvider
classes.description: Manages category budgets, provides methods to reload data, add spending, and compute usage ratios, while notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the provider and loads initial data asynchronously.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the budget data from the repository and updates the loading state.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Calculates and returns the usage ratio of a given Budget.

methods.name: addSpent
methods.description: Adds a spending delta to a budget and reloads the data.
